process: Freshwater usage, full-scale ion-exchange DLE at Salar del Hombre Muerto (Resources and inputs in DLE, p.157)
value: Full-scale DLE plant operating since 1996: Li+ captured on ion exchange resins and eluted with fresh water to a ~10 g/L LiCl solution, which is then concentrated in evaporation ponds before crystallization of Li2CO3.

process: Freshwater usage, evaporitic technology at Salar de Atacama and Salar de Olaroz (Resources and inputs in DLE, p.157; Fig. 1b, p.151)
value: Evaporitic technology: brine pumped into large shallow open-air ponds where over 90% of the water evaporates over 10-24 months, impurity salts crystallize, and the concentrated brine is refined to lithium carbonate with Na2CO3; fresh water is used for reagent dissolution, solvent scrubbing, crystal washing and steam generation.
